budget_items.what_was_recorded: Staff salaries had a little adjustment from last month and were reconciled with town figures; salaries are still a little under, and the rest of the budget is on track.
budget_items.quote: staff salaries little adjustment from last month, reconciled with town figures

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Someone was just hired for part-time summer work at an hourly rate, approved by Kerry.
budget_items.quote: just hired someone for part -time summer work, 12.08 per hour, kerry approved.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The figure recommended at the last trustees meeting was accepted, and local aid may not be funded at the recommended level; the Town Manager asked the board to consider using state aid to support additional hours.
budget_items.quote: kerry sent information that local aid may not be funded at recommended level.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State aid of $6,551.68 is due to Lunenburg and will be placed into the library; the library will have received $12,000+ this year.
